name: volcanic iron
lore_descriptor: dark iron shot through with veins of cooled magma, warm to the touch
first_pickup_chronicle: Volcanic iron. Smelted from ore that fell from a volcano's throat. It never quite goes cold. The frost-things will hate this.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 0.95, weight_mult 1.00, effective_against ice/frost creatures (T2 elemental, rare drop). Themed rare-of-the-tier — visual/generation cue only; no flat elemental damage per doc §Elemental effect.
